Subject: Security & Privacy: SOC 2 status, telemetry, and vendor questionnaire

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation walking through Acme Health's inference use case and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently undergoing a SOC 2 Type II audit (in progress). I attached a short status summary (SOC2-summary.pdf) that outlines scope and expected completion window. We can provide an interim security attestation if that helps procurement.
- HIPAA / PHI: We support HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment option (VPC / on-prem) and can sign a BAA for covered use cases. For hosted API customers we have controls but typically recommend Private for regulated PHI.
- Telemetry & Privacy: By default, our hosted Console collects anonymized usage metrics and error telemetry to help with support and performance tuning. Telemetry can be disabled or redacted in Private deployments; we also offer controls for cookie tracking on docs sites and product consoles.
- Vendor Security Questionnaire: I've attached the Vendor Security Questionnaire for Acme to review. If you prefer, we can send a fillable Doc with a security contact.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Aisha: confirm whether Acme will need a BAA (HIPAA) and whether you prefer hosted vs Private (this changes the implementation).
2) Acme / Security: complete or return the questionnaire — we can triage answers and loop in Neha (security lead) for any deep dives.
3) Schedule a 45-min tech deep dive with Neha + Dylan to walk telemetry, data flows, and encryption details — suggested window next week.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks — happy to align on timing.

Best,

Hi Aisha / Tom — quick answers inline and next steps.

- Telemetry details: Our hosted Console collects anonymized event metrics (page views, feature usage) and operational logs (errors, job latencies). We do not store full request/response payloads in telemetry by default; PII is redacted. IP addresses are collected in protected logs for anti-abuse and are purged on a configurable schedule. Retention windows are configurable for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers get a standard 90-day retention for telemetry unless we agree otherwise.

- Cookies / Docs analytics: Our public docs site uses first-party analytics (server-side) and a lightweight client-side analytics script for product analytics. We do not load third-party advertising trackers. For customers with strict cookie policies we can provide a cookie-consent config or host docs in a customer-controlled location.

- HIPAA / BAA: We can sign a BAA for Private deployments. If you need hosted with PHI we will need to evaluate controls — typically we recommend Private for PHI to keep data residency and KMS under customer control.

I've attached the SOC2 summary and the questionnaire again. I've also uploaded a one-page telemetry/data flow diagram to the Drive link below and added it to the questionnaire folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSECURITY
